hook: Magnetic particle imaging spots early brain bleeding in injured mice that MRI misses at 24 hours.
summary: Mice with a moderate closed-head injury received iron oxide nanoparticles, and magnetic particle imaging showed strong local signal at the impact site that faded by 7 days. Sham animals showed none, and only this method clearly marked the injury at 24 hours versus MRI. It is a mouse study of one injury model, so human diagnostic value is unproven.
title: Sensitive detection of in vivo traumatic brain injury foci using magnetic particle imaging.
